Three-Dimensional Margin Assessment Predicts Local Tumor Progression After Stereotactic Microwave Ablation of Small HCC ≤3 cm.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the impact of the minimal ablation margin (MAM) on local tumor progression (LTP) after stereotactic microwave ablation (MWA) of small hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) using three-dimensional quantitative ablation margin assessment (3D-QAM). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 175 lesions in 115 patients with HCC ≤ 3 cm treated with stereotactic MWA. The MAM was assessed using 3D-QAM analysis. Associations with LTP were evaluated using multivariable logistic regression. Model performance was assessed by receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis and internally validated using bootstrap resampling. Sensitivity analyses included generalized estimating equations (GEE) to account for clustering of lesions within patients. Additional analyses adjusted for re-ablation and included time-to-event analyses. RESULTS: LTP occurred in 36 of 175 lesions (20.6%). Lesions with LTP had significantly smaller margins compared with those without progression (2.9 vs. 4.7 mm, p < 0.001). The MAM was a strong independent protective factor (odds ratio 0.68 per millimeter increase, p < 0.001). Right-sided lesion location was associated with increased risk (odds ratio 2.75, p = 0.045), whereas multifocality was not significant. ROC analysis showed moderate discrimination (area under the curve 0.70). Internal validation demonstrated stable model performance with an optimism-corrected AUC of 0.73 and good calibration (slope 0.93). Results remained consistent in sensitivity analyses using GEE. Time-to-event analyses confirmed the MAM-LTPFS association. CONCLUSION: The MAM is a key determinant of LTP after stereotactic MWA of small HCC. Margin-based risk prediction is robust and supports the clinical use of three-dimensional margin assessment to optimize local tumor control.

summary.title_ko: 3차원 주변 연조직 평가가 간세포암종(HCC)의 국소 재발을 예측하는 데 미치는 영향: 3cm 이하 소형 간세포암종에 대한 입체적 고주파 열 치료(MWA)
summary.one_line: 소형 간세포암종(HCC)에 대한 입체적 고주파 열 치료(MWA) 후 국소 재발(LTP) 예측에 3차원 주변 연조직 평가(3D-QAM)를 통한 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM)가 중요한 역할을 한다는 것을 보여준다.
summary.intervention: 입체적 고주파 열 치료(stereotactic MWA)
summary.results: 국소 재발(LTP)은 175개의 병변 중 36개(20.6%)에서 발생했다. 국소 재발군(LTP)의 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM)는 2.9mm로, 재발 없는 군(4.7mm)보다 유의미하게 작았다 (p < 0.001). 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM) 1mm 증가 시 국소 재발 위험이 감소하는 독립적인 보호 인자였으며 odds ratio는 0.68, p < 0.001이었다.
summary.implication: 3차원 주변 연조직 평가(3D-QAM)를 활용한 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM) 평가는 입체적 고주파 열 치료(MWA) 후 간세포암종(HCC)의 국소 재발 위험을 예측하고, 치료 계획 수립에 도움을 줄 수 있다.
summary.detailed_results: 우측 병변 위치는 국소 재발 위험 증가와 관련이 있었으며 (odds ratio 2.75, p = 0.045), 다발성 병변은 유의미하지 않았다. ROC 분석 결과 AUC(Area Under the Curve)는 0.70으로 중간 정도의 감별력을 보였다. 부트스트랩 재샘플링을 통한 내부 검증 결과, optimism-corrected AUC는 0.73, calibration slope는 0.93으로 안정적인 성능을 나타냈다. Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE)를 사용한 민감도 분석에서도 결과가 일관되게 유지되었으며, time-to-event 분석은 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM)-국소 재발 자유 생존율(LTPFS) 연관성을 확인했다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 후향적 단일 센터 연구라는 한계점을 가지고 있으며, 환자 선택 편향 가능성이 존재한다. 또한, 3차원 주변 연조직 평가(3D-QAM)의 정확성과 재현성에 대한 추가적인 검증이 필요하다. 기존 연구와 비교했을 때, 본 연구는 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM)가 국소 재발 예측에 중요한 역할을 한다는 점을 명확히 보여주었다.
summary.clinical_application: 3차원 주변 연조직 평가(3D-QAM)를 활용하여 최소 주변 연조직 거리(MAM)를 측정하고, 이를 기반으로 입체적 고주파 열 치료(MWA) 계획을 수립하여 국소 재발 위험을 낮추는 데 활용할 수 있다. 특히 우측 병변 위치의 경우, 더 넓은 주변 연조직 확보를 고려해야 한다.

title: Drug-Eluting Stents Versus Drug-Coated Balloons Plus Bare-Metal Stents for the Treatment of Femoropopliteal Artery Lesions: Two-Year Outcomes from the TALENT Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare the 2-year outcomes of drug-eluting stents (DES) versus drug-coated balloons (DCB) plus bare-metal stents (BMS) in patients with femoropopliteal artery disease. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Data were analyzed from The Impact of Tibial Runoff on Clinical Outcome of Endovascular Therapy in Femoropopliteal Lesions (TALENT) Study, a multicenter, prospective study. Inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) was applied to balance baseline characteristics. The primary outcomes were freedom of all-cause mortality (f-ACM), freedom of major adverse events (f-MAE), clinically driven target lesion revascularization (CD-TLR), major adverse limb events (MALEs) and the secondary outcomes were the improvement in Rutherford classification and changes in quality of life assessed by the VascuQOL-25 questionnaire. RESULTS: A total of 429 patients were included (81 in DES group, 348 in DCB plus BMS group). During a median (Q1-Q3) follow-up of 20.2 months (11.6-27.1 months), no significant differences were observed between the two groups in 2-year f-ACM (91.4% vs 85.1%, p=0.096), f-MAE (79.6% vs 73.9%, p=0.330), CD-TLR (9.6% vs 12.6%, p=0.737) and MALEs (10.1% vs 12.3%, p=0.612). Both treatment modalities significantly improved in VascuQol score and Rutherford classification, with improvement rates of 76.1% and 71.3% at 24 months, respectively. An interaction effect (p=0.014 and 0.005, respectively) was observed for patients with intermittent claudication (R2-R3), suggesting that DES may be associated with lower risks of CD-TLR and MALEs. CONCLUSION: Over 2-year follow-up, DES and DCB plus BMS demonstrated favorable and comparable overall effectiveness in real-world patients with complex femoropopliteal lesions.

주요 결과:

* 주요 악성 사지 사건(major adverse limb events, MALEs): 10.1% vs 12.3%, p=0.612

title: Safety, efficacy, and 30-day follow-up of electrocautery biopsy tract closure: retrospective multicenter study.
abstract: PURPOSE: This retrospective analysis evaluated the safety and technical feasibility of a novel percutaneous biopsy tract electrocautery device. MATERIALS AND METHODS: 120 consecutive patients undergoing tract closure with SinglePass Kronos electrocautery following percutaneous solid organ and/or mass coaxial core needle biopsy (CCNB) were included. Outcomes included procedure time, observation time, adverse events, required treatments, and mortality. Pre- and post-procedure hematologic parameters were compared in a 65-patient subset. RESULTS: Patients were 62.0 ± 17.9 years old, 49.2% male and 50.8% female with target organs including liver (74; 61.7%), kidney (28; 23.3%), abdomen/mesentery (10; 8.3%), lung (5; 4.2%) and other (3; 2.5%). The most common indications included liver mass (38; 31.7%), medical liver disease (33; 27.5%), and medical renal disease (25; 20.8%). Antithrombotic medications (21; 17.5%) were held per Society of Interventional Radiology guidelines. Ultrasound- (52.5%) or CT-guided (47.5%) procedures were completed in 17 ± 8 minutes with outpatients discharged 2.8 + 1.2 hours post-procedure. There were no serious adverse events and four small intraprocedural hematomas did not progress following electrocautery. Through 30-days of follow-up, there were no instances of bleeding, transfusions, interventions, surgeries, or need for bleeding-related readmission or clinical encounter. There were no instances of significant hemoglobin drop (>1.5 g/dL) in the 65-patient subgroup and no immediate or delayed procedure-related deaths; five patients expired in hospice. CONCLUSION: Use of the SinglePass device demonstrated the technical feasibility of CCNB tract closure via electrocautery with no major safety signals observed, including no major bleeding, significant adverse events, or procedure-related deaths.

title: Systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression on the prognostic impact of narrow aortic bifurcation on outcomes of endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR).
abstract: BACKGROUND: This systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression evaluated whether the narrow aortic bifurcation (NAB) is associated with equal outcomes compared to regular aortic bifurcation (RAB) after endovascular aortic repair (EVAR). METHODS: A systematic literature search of MEDLINE, Embase, and Scopus was performed through August 2025. A random-effect-meta-analysis of proportion was conducted to calculate the pooled odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for outcomes of interest. The primary endpoint was limb patency, secondary endpoints included reintervention and overall mortality. Random-effects meta-regression models evaluated the impact of follow-up duration and bifurcation diameter cut-off on treatment effects. RESULTS: Twelve studies met the inclusion criteria (≈2,300 patients), of which eight were eligible for quantitative synthesis. The meta-analysis revealed no significant differences between NAB and RAB groups regarding primary limb patency, reintervention, or overall mortality with pooled ORs of 0.96 (95% CI, 0.51-1.82), 1.12 (95% CI, 0.58-2.14) and 0.89 (95% CI, 0.43-1.87), respectively. Heterogeneity was moderate across all outcomes (I2 = 25-48%, p>0.10). Meta-regression demonstrated no significant association between treatment effect and either follow-up duration or bifurcation diameter cut-off. The mean Newcastle-Ottawa Scale score was 6.6/9, indicating low-to-moderate risk of bias. CONCLUSIONS: In this systematic review and meta-analysis of contemporary studies with pooled quantitative and qualitative evidence, NAB was not associated with worse limb patency, reinterventions rates or mortality following EVAR. Overall, these findings may suggest that modern bifurcated endografts can be used safely and effectively in patients with narrow distal aortic anatomy when appropriate planning and technique are applied.

title: Emerging Role of Targeted Arterial Embolization in Achilles Tendinopathy.
abstract: Achilles tendinopathy (AT) affects approximately 6% of the general population, with 20% of patients remaining symptomatic at 10 years despite conservative therapy. Transarterial embolization (TAE) is an endovascular technique targeting aberrant neovascularization in tendinopathy. This review evaluates TAE's mechanistic rationale, technique, clinical efficacy, and emerging role in treating AT. Five published case series encompassing 139 patients (202 procedures) demonstrated consistent efficacy primarily in athletic populations. Pain scores decreased 60-83% from baseline (VAS/NRS 6.7-8.2) to final follow-up (1.4-2.7) at 6-24 months. VISA-A scores improved from 28.6-48.4 to 70.9-76.9 at 6 months, transitioning patients from severe to mild functional impairment. Clinical success (≥50% pain reduction) was achieved in 82-100% of patients. No major adverse events or tendon ruptures were reported. TAE for AT is an emerging therapy associated with meaningful pain reduction and a favorable safety profile in patients with refractory symptoms and angiographic hypervascularity, although specific patient indications remain understudied.

summary.title_ko: 아킬레스건염에서 표적 동맥 색전술의 새로운 역할
summary.one_line: 본 논문은 아킬레스건염 환자의 난치성 통증 완화를 위한 표적 동맥 색전술(TAE)의 효과와 안전성을 평가하고, 그 가능성을 제시합니다.
summary.intervention: 표적 동맥 색전술 (Transarterial Embolization, TAE): 비정상적인 신생혈관을 표적으로 하는 혈관내 시술
summary.results: 6-24개월 후 통증 점수는 기준선(VAS/NRS 6.7-8.2) 대비 60-83% 감소하여 최종 추적 관찰 시 1.4-2.7으로 나타났습니다. VISA-A 점수는 6개월 시점에 28.6-48.4에서 70.9-76.9로 개선되어 환자의 기능 장애 정도가 심각한 수준에서 경미한 수준으로 전환되었습니다. 임상적 성공률(≥50% 통증 감소)은 82-100%로 보고되었으며, 중대한 부작용이나 건 파열은 발생하지 않았습니다.
summary.implication: 아킬레스건염 환자에서 혈관 과다성(angiographic hypervascularity)이 확인되고 난치성 증상을 보이는 경우, 표적 동맥 색전술(TAE)은 통증 완화에 효과적이며 안전한 치료 옵션이 될 수 있습니다. 하지만 특정 환자의 적응증은 추가적인 연구가 필요합니다.

title: Mechanical Thrombectomy for High-Risk Pulmonary Embolism on ECMO: A Single-Center Retrospective Case Series.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the use of mechanical thrombectomy (MT) in patients who require veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VA-ECMO) for the management of acute high-risk pulmonary embolism. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective case series included patients who underwent VA-ECMO followed by MT for the treatment of pulmonary embolism between January 2017 and December 2025. Clinical, laboratory, and imaging data were collected from the electronic medical record. Outcomes included 30-day mortality and procedural complications. Potential risk factors for mortality were evaluated. Exploratory analyses between survivors and non-survivors were performed using the Mann-Whitney U test for continuous variables and Fisher's exact test for categorical variables. RESULTS: A total of 20 patients met inclusion criteria. The mortality rate was 15% (n=3) at 48 hours, 35% (n=7) at 30 days, and 45% (n=9) at six months. Procedure-related complications were present in 45% (n=9) of patients. Acute bleeding events occurred in 30% (n=6) of patients, and neurologic events occurred in 15% (n=3) of patients following ECMO cannulation and MT. No variables evaluated were significantly associated with mortality. CONCLUSION: In this single-center retrospective cohort, patients undergoing MT while supported with VA-ECMO for high-risk pulmonary embolism demonstrated a 30-day mortality of 35%. Further studies including matched controls and larger cohorts are needed to better define the role of MT in this critically ill population.

summary.title_ko: ECMO 지원 하에 기저 고위험성 폐색전증 환자에서의 기계적 혈전 제거술: 단일 기관 후향적 증례 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 급성 고위험성 폐색전증으로 인해 동맥-정맥 심폐 보조 장치(VA-ECMO)를 필요로 하는 환자에게 기계적 혈전 제거술(MT)의 효과와 안전성을 평가한 결과, 30일 사망률이 35%임을 보고하였다.
summary.subjects: 대상: 급성 고위험성 폐색전증으로 VA-ECMO를 받고 기계적 혈전 제거술(MT)을 시행한 환자, N=20
summary.intervention: 기계적 혈전 제거술 (Mechanical Thrombectomy, MT) - 동맥-정맥 심폐 보조 장치(Veno-Arterial Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation, VA-ECMO) 지원 하에 시행
summary.results: 30일 사망률: 35% (n=7), 48시간 사망률: 15% (n=3), 6개월 사망률: 45% (n=9). 시술 관련 합병증 발생률: 45% (n=9). 급성 출혈 발생률: 30% (n=6), 신경학적 사건 발생률: 15% (n=3).  사망과 관련된 유의미한 위험 인자는 발견되지 않았다.
summary.implication: ECMO 지원 하에 기계적 혈전 제거술은 고위험성 폐색전증 환자에게 고려될 수 있지만, 사망률이 높고 합병증 발생 가능성이 존재한다. 대조군을 포함하고 더 많은 환자를 대상으로 한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

title: Percutaneous Transbiliary Gastrostomy Tube Placement into a Roux-en-Y Remnant Stomach.
Percutaneous cholecystocutaneous stent-graft placement for large-bore gallbladder access to facilitate cholecystolithotomy: initial experience in 17 patients.
Combined Access Strategies for Portal Vein Recanalization with TIPS in Pediatric Chronic Portal Vein Thrombosis: A Series of Three Cases.
abstract: Portal vein recanalization with transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (PVR-TIPS) is an emerging endovascular option for pediatric chronic portal vein thrombosis with cavernous transformation. We describe three pediatric patients (11 months-11 years) who underwent successful PVR-TIPS using individualized transsplenic, transhepatic, and transjugular access strategies. Technical success was achieved in all cases, with restoration of portal venous flow, decompression of portal venous collaterals, and TIPS creation to maintain portal vein patency after recanalization. During follow-up, two patients developed shunt-related complications (stenosis or partial thrombosis) requiring successful reintervention, and all maintained functional shunt patency. One patient developed a hepatic arterioportal fistula that was successfully treated with endovascular embolization. These findings support PVR-TIPS as a feasible treatment option for selected pediatric patients with chronic portal vein thrombosis and complex portal venous anatomy, provided that close imaging surveillance is maintained.

summary.title_ko: 소아 만성 문맥혈전증 환자의 문맥동맥 재관류술과 TIPS(간내경피적 문-체계 우회루) 병행 접근 전략: 3례 보고
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 소아 만성 문맥혈전증 환자에서 개별화된 접근 전략을 이용한 문맥동맥 재관류술과 TIPS(TIPS) 병행 시술의 안전성과 유효성을 평가한 3례 증례 보고입니다.
summary.intervention: 문맥동맥 재관류술(Portal Vein Recanalization)과 TIPS(Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt, 간내경피적 문-체계 우회루) 병행 시술. 접근 전략은 환자별로 경췌적(transsplenic), 경간정맥적(transhepatic), 경정맥적(transjugular) 접근을 개별적으로 사용했습니다.
summary.results: 모든 경우에 기술적 성공(Technical Success)이 달성되었으며, 문맥혈류 재개통, 문맥 혈관 확장 압력 감소, 그리고 재관류술 후 문맥혈관 개통 유지를 위한 TIPS(TIPS) 생성에 성공했습니다. 추적 관찰 중 2명의 환자는 스펀트 관련 합병증(협착 또는 부분 혈전증)을 발생하여 재시술을 통해 해결했으며, 모든 환자는 기능적인 스펀트 개통 상태를 유지했습니다. 또한 1명의 환자는 간동맥-문맥 누공(hepatic arterioportal fistula)이 발생했지만, 내시경 색전술(endovascular embolization)을 통해 성공적으로 치료했습니다.
summary.implication: 본 연구 결과는 복잡한 문맥혈관 해부 구조를 가진 선택된 소아 만성 문맥혈전증 환자에게 PVR-TIPS(문맥동맥 재관류술과 TIPS 병행 시술)가 효과적인 치료 옵션이 될 수 있음을 시사합니다. 하지만, 지속적인 영상 관찰을 통해 합병증 발생 가능성을 모니터링해야 합니다.

title: Rapid Endovascular Hemorrhage Control in Trauma: a Joint Position Statement from the American College of Surgeons Committee on Trauma and the Society of Interventional Radiology.
abstract: Timely hemorrhage control is a critical determinant of survival after traumatic injury. Advances in endovascular techniques have expanded the role of interventional radiology, making it an essential component of contemporary trauma care. This position statement affirms the importance of rapid hemorrhage control, emphasizes the role of interventional radiologists as integral members of multidisciplinary trauma teams, and clarifies expectations related to the American College of Surgeons Verification, Review, and Consultation (VRC) Program standards for interventional radiology resources and availability. It also provides guidance for trauma centers to optimize institutional processes and coordination between trauma surgery and interventional radiology to ensure timely and effective hemorrhage control for injured patients.

summary.title_ko: 외상 환자의 신속한 혈관내 출혈 조절: 미국 외과 의사회 외상 위원회 및 영상의학중재학회 공동 입장 발표
summary.one_line: 본 논문은 외상 환자에서 신속한 혈관내 지혈의 중요성을 강조하고, 영상의학중재학과 전문의를 다학제 외상 팀의 핵심 구성원으로 지정하며, 미국 외과 의사회 검증, 검토 및 자문 프로그램(Verification, Review, and Consultation; VRC) 기준에 따른 영상의학중재학 관련 자원 및 가용성을 명확히 제시합니다.
summary.intervention: 혈관내 지혈술(Endovascular Hemorrhage Control) - 간동맥화학색전술(TACE), 경동맥폐쇄술(Embolization) 등 영상의학중재학과 시술 포함
summary.results:
본 입장 발표는 구체적인 수치 데이터를 제시하지 않지만, 다음과 같은 내용을 강조합니다: 
*   외상 환자의 생존율 결정 요인은 적절한 시기의 출혈 조절입니다.
*   영상의학중재술(Interventional Radiology) 기술 발전으로 영상의학중재학과 전문의의 역할이 외상 치료에서 필수적으로 자리 잡았습니다.
*   다학제 팀 내에서 영상의학중재학과 전문의의 적극적인 참여가 중요합니다.
*   외상센터는 기관 내 프로세스 및 외과와 영상의학중재학과 간의 협력을 최적화하여 신속하고 효과적인 출혈 조절을 보장해야 합니다.
summary.implication: 본 입장 발표는 외상 치료 과정에서 혈관내 지혈술(Endovascular Hemorrhage Control)의 중요성을 인식시키고, 영상의학중재학과 전문의를 다학제 팀에 통합하여 환자의 생존율 향상을 목표로 하는 기관 내 프로세스 개선을 촉구합니다. 특히 미국 외과 의사회 VRC 프로그램 기준 준수를 통해 영상의학중재학 관련 자원 확보 및 가용성을 높이는 것이 중요함을 강조합니다.

title: Retrograde Replacement of a Dislodged Percutaneous Nephroureteral Catheter Using a Foley-Assisted Monorail Technique.
Establishing a Rodent Model of Venous Stent Thrombosis and In-Stent Restenosis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To establish a controlled small-animal model of venous stent placement enabling longitudinal evaluation of thrombosis, vessel wall remodeling, and in-stent restenosis (ISR). Antithrombotic treatment arms were included to assess the model's responsiveness to biologic differences. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Forty-four adult Sprague Dawley rats were randomized into saline (control), rivaroxaban, or clopidogrel groups. Self-expanding nitinol stents were deployed in the inferior vena cava (IVC). Stent patency and blood flow were assessed via high-frequency ultrasound (HFUS) at 1, 4, and 8 weeks. Histology was performed to evaluate neointimal hyperplasia and ISR. RESULTS: Procedural success was 100%, with a 77.2% survival rate at 24 hours (34/44). Rivaroxaban-treated rats showed the highest stent patency and preserved flow velocities at 1 week (169 ± 54 mm/s vs. 98 ± 53 mm/s, p < 0.001). Clopidogrel-treated animals exhibited intermediate outcomes. At 8 weeks, control animals had the highest incidence of ISR and thrombosis. No significant difference in peak systolic velocities was noted in controls between 1 week (98 ± 53 mm/s) and 1 month (83 ± 24 mm/s; p = 0.327). At 4 weeks, 67% of controls, 80% of clopidogrel, and 100% of rivaroxaban-treated stents remained patent. CONCLUSION: This study establishes a small-animal venous stent platform that integrates longitudinal imaging with structural validation of thrombosis and remodeling. The model demonstrates sensitivity to pharmacologic modulation and provides a foundation for mechanistic investigation and preclinical evaluation of venous stent therapies.

summary.title_ko: 정맥 스텐트 혈전증 및 스텐트 내 재협착(In-Stent Restenosis, ISR) 동물 모델 확립
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 정맥 스텐트 삽입 후 발생하는 혈전증과 스텐트 내 재협착을 평가하고 약물 효과를 검증할 수 있는 쥐 기반 동물 모델을 개발하여 그 유효성을 입증하였다.
summary.design: 전향적 무작위 배정 연구 (Prospective Randomized Controlled Trial, RCT)
summary.intervention: 하부 정맥(Inferior Vena Cava, IVC)에 자가 확장 니티놀 스텐트 삽입 후 생리식염수(control), 리바록사반(rivaroxaban), 클로피도그렐(clopidogrel) 투여
summary.results: 절차 성공률 100%, 24시간 생존율 77.2% (34/44). 1주 차에 리바록사반 투여군은 스텐트 개통 유지 및 혈류 속도(169 ± 54 mm/s vs. 98 ± 53 mm/s, p < 0.001)가 가장 높게 나타남. 클로피도그렐 투여군은 중간 정도의 결과를 보였음. 8주 차에 대조군에서 스텐트 내 재협착 및 혈전증 발생률이 가장 높았으며, 4주 시점에 대조군의 67%, 클로피도그렐 투여군의 80%, 리바록사반 투여군의 100%에서 스텐트 개통 유지됨. 대조군에서는 1주 차(98 ± 53 mm/s)와 1개월 시점(83 ± 24 mm/s) 사이의 최고 수축기 혈류 속도 차이가 유의하지 않음 (p = 0.327).
summary.implication: 본 연구에서 확립된 동물 모델은 정맥 스텐트 관련 혈전증 및 재협착 기전을 연구하고 새로운 치료법을 사전 임상적으로 평가하는 데 활용될 수 있으며, 특히 약물 효과를 검증하는 데 유용할 것으로 기대된다.

title: Augmented and Virtual Reality for Preprocedural Planning in Hepatic Transarterial Interventional Oncology: A Pilot Study in 50 Cases.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the feasibility, usability, and perceived impact of augmented and virtual reality (AR/VR) for preprocedural planning in transarterial interventional oncology procedures, as assessed through structured operator surveys. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This IRB-approved, single-center pilot study was conducted over 1 year (September 2024-September 2025). Interventional radiologists used an AR/VR headset (Apple Vision Pro; Apple Inc., Cupertino, CA) with Visage Ease VP software (Visage Imaging, San Diego, CA) to review patient-specific volume renderings of cone-beam CT and cross-sectional imaging before complex oncologic procedures. Cases included hepatic angiography prior to Y90 radioembolization (n=42), percutaneous hepatic perfusion (n=7), and transarterial chemoembolization (n=1). Operators completed structured surveys assessing workflow integration, anatomic visualization, confidence, usability, and comfort using 5-point Likert scales (1=worst, 5=best). RESULTS: Fifty cases were analyzed, with a median case time of 81.0 minutes (IQR, 62.0-102.0). The median AR/VR planning time was 5 min [IQR 3.0-6.0], corresponding to a median of 6% of total case duration. AR/VR planning changed the procedural approach in 23 of 50 cases (46%). Likert score for procedural change had an overall mean of 3.3±1.3, with mean scores of 2.4±0.7 in cases where AR/VR did not influence the operator's intraprocedural approach and 4.4±0.8 in cases where AR/VR did influence the approach. Anatomic visualization scored 4.7±0.8, anatomic understanding 4.7±0.9, and procedural confidence 4.6±1.0. Workflow integration scored 4.8±0.5, system usability 4.5±0.9, and headset comfort 1.9±1.1. Specific use cases are described. CONCLUSION: AR/VR-based preprocedural planning was feasible, efficient, and enhanced perceived anatomic understanding, procedural confidence, and planning in transarterial interventional oncology cases. Headset comfort remains a limitation.

summary.title_ko: 간동맥암 화학색전술 전 절차 계획에 대한 증강현실 및 가상현실의 활용: 50례의 파일럿 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 간동맥암 화학색전술(TACE) 전 절차 계획 시 증강현실(AR)/가상현실(VR) 기술이 의료진의 이해도, 자신감 향상 및 절차 변경에 긍정적인 영향을 미침을 확인하였으며, 헤드셋 착용 편안함은 개선해야 할 과제로 나타났다.
summary.subjects: 대상: 50례 (간동맥화학색전술(TACE) 전 간혈관조영술(hepatic angiography) 42례, 경피적 간 투여술(percutaneous hepatic perfusion) 7례, 간동맥화학색전술(TACE) 1례)
summary.intervention: 증강현실(AR)/가상현실(VR) 헤드셋 (Apple Vision Pro)과 Visage Ease VP 소프트웨어 (Visage Imaging)를 이용한 환자 맞춤형 입체 영상 검토
summary.results: 총 사례 시간 중앙값 81.0분 (IQR, 62.0-102.0), AR/VR 계획 시간 중앙값 5분 [IQR 3.0-6.0]로 전체 사례 기간의 중앙값 6%를 차지함. AR/VR 계획은 50례 중 23례(46%)에서 절차적 접근 방식 변경을 유도함. 절차 변경에 대한 Likert 점수는 평균 3.3±1.3점, AR/VR이 절차적 접근 방식에 영향을 미치지 않은 경우 2.4±0.7점, 영향을 미친 경우 4.4±0.8점으로 나타남.
summary.implication: AR/VR 기반 전 절차 계획은 간동맥암 화학색전술(TACE)과 같은 시술에서 환자 이해도 향상 및 자신감 증진에 기여할 수 있다.
summary.detailed_results: 해부학적 시각화 점수는 4.7±0.8점, 해부학적 이해 점수는 4.7±0.9점, 절차적 자신감 점수는 4.6±1.0점으로 높게 평가되었음. 워크플로우 통합 점수는 4.8±0.5점, 시스템 사용성 점수는 4.5±0.9점, 헤드셋 착용 편안함 점수는 1.9±1.1점으로 낮게 나타남.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 단일 센터에서 진행된 파일럿 연구이며, AR/VR 헤드셋의 착용 편안함이 주요 제한 사항으로 지적됨. 또한, 장기적인 효과 및 비용 효율성에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.
summary.clinical_application: AR/VR 기술은 복잡한 간동맥암 화학색전술(TACE) 전 절차 계획 시 의료진의 의사 결정을 지원하고 환자 치료 결과 개선에 기여할 수 있으며, 향후 헤드셋 디자인 개선을 통해 착용 편안함을 높이는 노력이 필요하다.

title: Mechanical Thrombectomy for Acute Ischemic Stroke Performed at High Volume Institutions Results in Better Patient Outcomes.
abstract: PURPOSE: To examine the relationship between patient outcomes and mechanical thrombectomy volumes since the implementation of extended time window thrombectomies. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Data were obtained from the National Inpatient Sample maintained by the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality. The annual volumes of mechanical thrombectomy were collected at the institutional level during 2017-2021 using the International Classification of Diseases, 10th revision and clinical modification codes. For the statistical analysis, a multivariate logistic regression analysis was used to analyze the effect of mechanical thrombectomy volume on mortality while controlling for the following: race, age, case complication, institution bed size, institution region, and institutional location/teaching status. RESULTS: There were 27,797 mechanical thrombectomy cases identified in the National Inpatient Sample during 2017-2021, which corresponds to a national estimate of 138,985 total cases during this timeframe. Case volumes increased every year from 2017 to 2021. Over this time period, there was a 1.2% reduction in odds of mortality per every 10 mechanical thrombectomy case increase (OR (95% CI): 0.988 (0.980, 0.995), p=0.001. The total complication rate in this series of patients was 71.7%, with 40.5% of all patients having cardiac complications and 30.5% of all patients having pulmonary complications. CONCLUSION: Improved mechanical thrombectomy outcomes continue to be observed at high-volume institutions despite the implementation of the extended time window for thrombectomy, though cardiac and pulmonary complications constitute a significant source of morbidity and may represent an opportunity to improve outcomes at low-volume centers.

summary.title_ko: 고집행 의료기관에서의 기계적 혈전 제거술은 급성 허혈성 뇌졸중 환자의 예후를 개선한다
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 급성 허혈성 뇌졸중에 대한 기계적 혈전 제거술의 집행량과 환자 예후 사이의 관계를 분석한 결과, 고집행 의료기관에서 더 나은 결과를 보이는 것을 확인했습니다.
summary.intervention: 기계적 혈전 제거술(Mechanical Thrombectomy) - 2017년~2021년 기간 동안 집행량 분석
summary.results: 기계적 혈전 제거술 건수가 10건 증가할 때마다 사망 위험이 1.2% 감소했습니다 (OR (95% CI): 0.988 (0.980, 0.995), p=0.001). 전체 합병증 발생률은 71.7%였으며, 심장 합병증은 40.5%, 폐 합병증은 30.5%로 나타났습니다.
summary.implication: 기계적 혈전 제거술의 예후 개선은 확장된 시간 창(extended time window) 적용에도 불구하고 고집행 의료기관에서 지속적으로 관찰됩니다. 심장 및 폐 합병증이 중요한 질병 부담으로 작용하며, 저집행 기관에서도 결과 개선을 위한 기회를 제공할 수 있습니다.

title: Within-Patient Association Between Improvement in Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms and Change in Sexual Function After Prostatic Artery Embolization.
abstract: This single-center retrospective study analyzed the degree of association between urinary symptom improvement and erectile or ejaculatory function change in patients after prostatic artery embolization (PAE) for lower urinary tract symptoms secondary to benign prostatic hyperplasia. Urinary symptom severity (IPSS), erectile function (SHIM), and ejaculatory function (MSHQ-EjD) were assessed at baseline, 3 months, and 12 months after PAE. Among the 183 patients treated from 2014 to 2023, mean IPSS improved by 12.0 points. After adjustment for age, baseline score, medications, and vascular comorbidities, urinary-score change was associated with erectile-function-score change at the first (partial r = -0.17; P = .025) and second follow-up (partial r = -0.25; P = .020), strengthening in the baseline erectile-dysfunction subgroup (partial r = -0.38; P = .008). Strong urinary responders more often achieved the erectile-function minimal clinically important difference (26.3% vs 3.8%; P = .014). No significant association was found with ejaculatory function.

summary.title_ko: 전립선 동맥 색전술(PAE) 후 하부 요로 증상 개선 정도와 성 기능 변화 간의 상관관계 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 전립선 동맥 색전술(PAE) 시행 환자에서 하부 요로 증상 호전 정도가 발기 및 사정 기능 변화에 미치는 영향을 분석한 결과, 하부 요로 증상이 많이 개선된 환자군에서 발기 기능이 더 많이 회복되는 경향을 보였다.
summary.subjects: 대상: 2014년~2023년 전립선 비대증으로 인한 하부 요로 증상 치료를 위해 전립선 동맥 색전술(PAE)을 받은 환자 N=183명
summary.intervention: 시술 또는 중재: 전립선 동맥 색전술(Prostatic Artery Embolization, PAE)
summary.results: 연구 결과, 시술 후 평균 IPSS (국제 남성 배뇨 장애 지수, International Prostate Symptom Score)는 12.0점 감소했다. 나이, 기준 IPSS 점수, 약물 복용, 혈관 동반 질환 등을 보정한 후, 하부 요로 증상 점수 변화는 첫 번째(3개월) 추적 관찰 시 발기 기능 점수 변화와 부분 상관관계(partial r = -0.17; P = .025)를 보였고, 두 번째(12개월) 추적 관찰 시에는 부분 상관관계(partial r = -0.25; P = .020)가 더욱 강해졌다. 특히 발기 부전 환자군에서 이러한 경향이 더 뚜렷하게 나타났으며 (partial r = -0.38; P = .008). 하부 요로 증상이 많이 호전된 환자는 발기 기능의 최소 임상적으로 유의한 차이(Minimal Clinically Important Difference, MCID)를 달성할 가능성이 높았다 (26.3% vs 3.8%; P = .014). 사정 기능과 관련된 유의미한 상관관계는 발견되지 않았다.
summary.implication: 전립선 동맥 색전술(PAE)은 하부 요로 증상 개선뿐만 아니라 발기 기능을 회복하는 데도 도움이 될 수 있으며, 특히 기존 발기 부전 환자에게 더욱 효과적일 수 있다. 사정 기능에 대한 영향은 없는 것으로 보인다.

title: Catheter-Associated Tumor Thrombus: A Consideration Beyond Bland Thrombus and Fibrin Sheath.
Development of a Custom 7-DOF Robotic Prostate Fusion Biopsy System utilizing 3-Point Volumetric Co-Registration: Technical Description and Initial Clinical Feasibility.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To introduce a novel 7-DOF (Degrees of Freedom) robotic prostate biopsy system utilizing a "3-point volumetric fusion" algorithm, evaluating its clinical feasibility and comparative diagnostic yield against standard systematic biopsy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A prospective analysis was conducted on 48 biopsy-naïve patients with mpMRI lesions (PI-RADS ≥3) biopsied using a proprietary 7-DOF robotic system. The software integrates pre-operative MRI with real-time transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) using three internal anatomical landmarks to compensate for organ deformation. Patients underwent Robotic Targeted Biopsy (TB) followed by a 12-core Systematic Biopsy (SB) performed via the robot's joystick control. Primary outcomes were Overall Cancer Detection Rate (CDR) and quantitative tumor burden. RESULTS: Prostate cancer was detected in 23 (47.9%) of 48 patients (mean age 64.5 years, PSA 7.2 ng/mL). The cancer detection rate was 47.9% for TB and 43.8% for SB, with a p-value of 0.48, indicating no statistically significant difference. In cancer-positive cases, the mean tumor involvement in Robotic TB cores was 68.5%, which was significantly greater than the 31.4% observed in Systematic SB cores (p<0.01). Cancer was detected exclusively by Robotic TB in two biopsy-naive patients (8.7%) harboring anterior lesions. CONCLUSION: The evaluated 7-DOF robotic system demonstrates high safety and clinical feasibility. Consistent with the established biological advantages of image guidance, the targeted approach yields substantially higher tumor volume samples than systematic biopsy.

summary.title_ko: 3점 체적 융합 알고리즘을 이용한 맞춤형 7-DOF 로봇 전립선 융합 생검 시스템 개발: 기술적 설명 및 초기 임상 타당성 평가
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 새로운 7-자유도(Degrees of Freedom) 로봇 전립선 생검 시스템의 안전성과 임상 타당성을 평가하고, 기존 체계적 생검 대비 종양 표본 크기 측면에서 우수함을 확인했습니다.
summary.intervention: 시술 또는 중재: 로봇 표적 생검(Robotic Targeted Biopsy, TB) 후 로봇 조이스틱을 이용한 12코어 체계적 생검(Systematic Biopsy, SB). 소프트웨어는 수술 전 MRI와 실시간 항문 직장 초음파(Transrectal Ultrasound, TRUS)를 세 개의 내부 해부학적 지표점을 이용하여 장기 변형에 대한 보정을 통해 통합합니다.
summary.results: 전립선암은 48명 중 23명 (47.9%)에서 진단되었습니다. TB의 암 발견율은 47.9%, SB는 43.8%였으며, p-value는 0.48로 통계적으로 유의한 차이가 없었습니다. 암이 확인된 경우, 로봇 TB 코어에서의 평균 종양 침범률은 68.5%였고, 이는 체계적 SB 코어에서 관찰된 31.4%보다 유의미하게 높았습니다 (p<0.01). 전립선암 경험이 없는 환자 중 2명(8.7%)에서 앞쪽 위치한 병변을 로봇 TB만으로 진단했습니다.
summary.implication: 새로운 7-DOF 로봇 시스템은 높은 안전성과 임상 타당성을 보여주며, 영상 유도 접근법의 생물학적 이점을 고려할 때 체계적 생검보다 훨씬 큰 종양 표본을 얻을 수 있습니다. 특히 앞쪽 위치한 전립선암 진단에 효과적일 것으로 예상됩니다.

title: Variability of S1 and S2 Intra-Sacral Corridor Height in Cone-Beam Computed Tomography-Guided Percutaneous Pelvic Screw Fixation: A Retrospective Study of 115 Patients.
abstract: PURPOSE: To test the hypothesis that S1 and S2 intra-sacral corridor height shows substantial inter-individual variability but is not associated with operative time or radiation exposure in patients undergoing CBCT-guided percutaneous pelvic osteosynthesis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 115 consecutive patients treated between March 2023 and November 2025 with CBCT-guided percutaneous pelvic screw fixation for traumatic or fragility fractures. Patients who received at least one screw in an S1 and/or S2 intra-sacral corridor were included. Corridor height was measured on follow-up CT using standardized multiplanar "true outlet" reconstructions. The primary endpoint was to explore the variability of corridor height. Secondary endpoints were to assess operative time, radiation exposure, and adverse events. RESULTS: A total of 169 screws were inserted in 115 patients (median age 67 years). Median intra-sacral corridor height was 23 mm (interquartile range 21-26 mm), with a minimum of 10 mm and a maximum of 32 mm. Median operative time was 47 minutes, and median DAP was 78.8 Gy·cm2. No significant correlation was observed between corridor height and operative time (Spearman's ρ = 0.043, P = 0.65) or radiation exposure (Spearman's ρ = -0.057, P = 0.55). One adverse event (0.6%) was reported, not associated with smaller corridor height. CONCLUSION: S1 and S2 intra-sacral corridors exhibit substantial anatomical variability. In this cohort of CBCT-guided percutaneous pelvic osteosyntheses, corridor height did not influence operative time or radiation exposure. One adverse event was observed. These findings suggest that three-dimensional CBCT planning may facilitate safe and efficient screw placement despite sacral anatomical variations.

summary.title_ko: 콘빔컴퓨터단층촬영(CBCT) 유도 경피 골반 나사 고정술에서 S1 및 S2 체내-경골관 높이의 변동성: 후향적 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 CBCT를 이용한 경피 골반 나사 고정술 시 S1 및 S2 체내-경골관 높이가 상당한 개인별 차이를 보이지만, 수술 시간이나 방사선 노출에 영향을 미치지 않는다는 것을 확인했습니다.
summary.design: 후향적 단일 센터 연구 (Retrospective Single-Center Study)
summary.subjects: 총 115명의 환자 (중앙값 나이 67세), 총 169개의 나사 삽입
summary.intervention: CBCT 유도 경피 골반 나사 고정술(Percutaneous Pelvic Screw Fixation)
summary.results: S1 및 S2 체내-경골관 높이의 중앙값은 23 mm (4분위 범위: 21-26 mm), 최소 10 mm, 최대 32 mm였습니다. 수술 시간의 중앙값은 47분, DAP(Dose Area Product)는 78.8 Gy·cm²였습니다. 체내-경골관 높이와 수술 시간 간에는 유의미한 상관관계가 없었습니다 (Spearman's ρ = 0.043, P = 0.65). 방사선 노출(DAP)과 체내-경골관 높이 간에도 유의미한 상관관계가 없었습니다 (Spearman's ρ = -0.057, P = 0.55).  부작용은 1건(0.6%) 보고되었으며, 이는 낮은 체내-경골관 높이와 관련되지 않았습니다.
summary.implication: 3차원 CBCT 계획은 골반 해부학적 변이에 관계없이 안전하고 효율적인 나사 삽입을 가능하게 할 수 있습니다.

title: Emergency Interventional Radiology in Rural Japan: Spatial Transfer Patterns, Temporal Workload Distribution, and the Clinical and Procedural Spectrum with Implications for Regional Interventional Radiology Workforce and Care Systems.
abstract: PURPOSE: To characterize emergency interventional radiology (IR) practice at a tertiary care center in a rural Japanese prefecture, focusing on spatial transfer patterns, temporal workload distribution, and the clinical and procedural spectrum. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included patients who underwent emergency IR between February 2023 and April 2025. Patient demographics, referral status, medical region, procedure timing, indications, procedural categories, and 7-day and 30-day outcomes were analyzed. Inter-regional transfer patterns were evaluated using both former eight and current three secondary medical service areas, with transfer rates standardized per 100,000 population. RESULTS: A total of 150 emergency IR procedures were analyzed. Most procedures involved interhospital transfers (64.0%), while 36.0% were in-hospital emergencies. Among transferred patients, the median transfer distance was 40 km, the median time to procedure was 339 min, and no significant association was observed between transfer distance and time to procedure. Population-adjusted transfer rates differed from absolute case counts. After-hours procedures accounted for 65.3% of all cases. Non-neoplastic conditions were the most frequent indication. Embolization constituted 89% of procedures. The 7-day and 30-day mortality rate was 6% and 10.7%, consistent with previously reported outcomes. CONCLUSION: Emergency IR in this rural prefecture was characterized by substantial inter-regional patient transfers, a high after-hours workload, and a predominance of embolization procedures for hemorrhagic conditions. Given the low case volume per region and limited workforce, a centralized hub-based model with structured regional transfer systems may represent a practical and sustainable approach for delivering emergency IR services in rural settings.

summary.title_ko: 일본 농촌 지역의 응급 영상의학적 개입: 공간 이동 패턴, 시간별 작업량 분포 및 임상/시술 스펙트럼 분석 – 지역 영상의학과 인력 및 의료 시스템에 대한 함의

summary.results:
• 총 150건의 응급 영상의학적 개입 시술 분석
• 병원 간 이동 환자 비율: 64.0%, 입원 내 응급 상황: 36.0%
• 병원 간 이동 거리 중앙값: 40km, 시술까지 소요 시간 중앙값: 339분 (이동 거리와 시술 시간 사이 연관성 없음)

• 7일 사망률: 6%, 30일 사망률: 10.7% (기존 보고된 결과와 일관적)
summary.implication: 농촌 지역의 낮은 환자 발생 건수 및 제한적인 인력을 고려할 때, 중앙 집중화된 허브-앤-스포크(hub-and-spoke) 모델과 체계적인 지역 이동 시스템을 통해 응급 영상의학적 개입 서비스를 제공하는 것이 실용적이고 지속 가능한 접근 방식이 될 수 있다.

title: Ablative Radioembolization Dosing Thresholds for Glass Microspheres Predictive of Complete Imaging Response and Survival in Patients with Hepatocellular Carcinomas Larger than 4 cm: a Multi-institution Retrospective Analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate radiographic complete response (CR) as a biomarker for survival and compare dosimetry models that predict CR in HCCs ≥4cm treated with glass microsphere TARE. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective multi-center analysis included 112 consecutive patients who underwent TARE for untreated HCC ≥4cm between June 2018-June 2024. Imaging response was assessed by modified Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (mRECIST). Post-TARE SPECT/CT were analyzed using voxel-based dosimetry software to estimate dose. Associations between dose, imaging response, and clinical outcomes were evaluated. RESULTS: 58 patients (51.8%) had CR three months post-TARE. CR was associated with improved overall survival (OS). Post-hoc estimated doses were significantly higher in patients with CR: 592 versus 316 Gy single-compartment perfused dose, 482 versus 213 Gy D95, and 828 versus 401 Gy D50. Multiple dose thresholds correlated with CR and overall survival including D95. Area under the curve (AUC) by receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis and modeled complete response probability did not differ significantly between single-compartment and voxel-based dose estimates. CONCLUSIONS: For HCC > 4 cm, CR at three months correlated with OS. Higher single-compartment dose thresholds or voxel-based dosimetry thresholds than currently recommended may better predict CR in HCC tumors ≥4 cm treated with glass microsphere TARE.

summary.title_ko: 4cm 이상의 간세포암종 환자에서 유리 마이크로구체(glass microsphere) 간동맥화학색전술(TACE) 투여량 기준이 완전 영상 반응 및 생존율을 예측하는가: 다기관 후향적 분석
summary.one_line: 간세포암종(HCC) 환자에서 유리 마이크로구체 간동맥화학색전술(TACE) 후 완전 영상 반응(CR)은 생존율과 관련되며, CR을 예측하는 투여량 기준에 대한 새로운 시사점을 제공한다.
summary.subjects: 대상: 2018년 6월부터 2024년 6월까지 유리 마이크로구체 간동맥화학색전술(TACE)을 시행한 치료 경험이 없는 4cm 이상의 간세포암종(HCC) 환자, N=112
summary.intervention: 유리 마이크로구체 간동맥화학색전술(TACE)
summary.results: 3개월 후 완전 영상 반응(CR)을 보인 환자는 58명 (51.8%) 이었으며, CR은 전체 생존율(OS) 향상과 관련 있었다. 완전 영상 반응(CR) 환자의 경우, 단일 구획 관류 투여량(single-compartment perfused dose): 592 Gy vs 316 Gy, D95: 482 Gy vs 213 Gy, D50: 828 Gy vs 401 Gy가 유의미하게 높았다.
summary.implication: 간세포암종(HCC)에서 완전 영상 반응(CR)은 생존율과 관련이 있으며, 현재 권장되는 투여량보다 높은 단일 구획 또는 복셀 기반 방사선 투여량 기준이 4cm 이상의 간세포암종 환자에서 유리 마이크로구체 간동맥화학색전술(TACE) 시 CR 예측에 더 적합할 수 있다.
summary.detailed_results: ROC 분석 및 모델링된 완전 영상 반응 확률은 단일 구획 및 복셀 기반 방사선 투여량 추정치 간에 유의미한 차이를 보이지 않았다. 3개월 후 완전 영상 반응(CR)을 보인 환자의 전체 생존율(OS)이 더 높았다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 후향적 디자인으로 인해 인과 관계를 명확히 규명하기 어렵고, 다양한 병기 및 치료 요인을 고려하지 못했을 수 있다는 한계점을 가지고 있다. 또한, 추적 기간이 제한적일 수 있으며, 환자군 구성의 이질성이 존재할 가능성을 배제할 수 없다.
summary.clinical_application: 유리 마이크로구체 간동맥화학색전술(TACE) 시행 시, 환자의 종양 크기 및 특성을 고려하여 더 높은 방사선 투여량을 목표로 설정하는 것이 완전 영상 반응(CR)을 유도하고 생존율 향상에 기여할 수 있다. 향후 전향적 연구를 통해 이러한 결과를 검증하고 최적의 투여량 기준을 확립해야 한다.

title: Clinical and Metabolic Outcomes of Radiofrequency Ablation with Vertebral Augmentation for Symptomatic Spinal Osteolytic Lesions in Multiple Myeloma.
abstract: This retrospective single-center study evaluated clinical and local metabolic outcomes after radiofrequency ablation (RFA) combined with vertebral augmentation in patients with multiple myeloma and symptomatic spinal osteolytic lesions. Twenty patients with 45 lesions underwent treatment between 2018 and 2024 (mean follow-up, 14.6 months). Pain, disability, and functional status were assessed using the visual analog scale (VAS), Oswestry Disability Index (ODI), and Karnofsky Performance Status (KPS). PET-CT at 3-6 months evaluated FDG uptake at treated lesions. Mean VAS improved from 8.2 to 3.8 at 12 months (P < .001), with parallel improvements in ODI and KPS. Mean SUV_max decreased by 62.5% at treated lesions. No new vertebral fractures or progressive collapse were observed, and 2 minor adverse events occurred. RFA combined with vertebral augmentation was associated with sustained pain relief, functional improvement, and reduced FDG uptake, supporting its role as a local palliative and stabilizing therapy.

summary.title_ko: 다발성 골수종 환자의 증상 있는 척추 골용해 병변에 대한 고주파 열전기 치료(Radiofrequency Ablation)와 척추 강화술(Vertebral Augmentation)의 임상적 및 대사적 결과
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 다발성 골수종 환자의 증상 있는 척추 골용해 병변에 대한 고주파 열전기 치료와 척추 강화술 병행 시 통증 완화, 기능 개선, FDG(플루오르데옥시글루코스) 흡수 감소를 확인하여 국소적 완화 및 안정화 요법으로서의 가능성을 제시한다.
summary.subjects: 다발성 골수종 환자 20명, 총 45개의 병변 (평균 추적 관찰 기간: 14.6개월)
summary.intervention: 고주파 열전기 치료(RFA)와 척추 강화술(Vertebral Augmentation) 병행
summary.results:
• 시술 후 12개월 시점의 평균 통증 시각 아날로그 척도(VAS, Visual Analog Scale) 점수는 8.2에서 3.8로 개선됨 (P < .001). 
• 오스웨스트리 장애 지수(ODI, Oswestry Disability Index) 및 카르노프스키 수행 상태 점수(KPS, Karnofsky Performance Status) 또한 동반하여 호전됨.
• 시술 부위 병변의 평균 SUV_max (표준화된 최대 흡수 값, Standardized Uptake Value max)는 62.5% 감소함.
• 새로운 척추 골절 또는 진행성 압박은 관찰되지 않았으며, 경미한 부작용이 2건 발생.
summary.implication: 고주파 열전기 치료와 척추 강화술 병행 요법은 지속적인 통증 완화, 기능 개선, FDG 흡수 감소를 가져오므로 다발성 골수종 환자의 증상 있는 척추 골용해 병변에 대한 국소적 완화 및 안정화 요법으로서의 역할을 뒷받침한다.

title: TREATMENT ALGORITHM FOR PATIENTS WITH NONTHROMBOTIC ILIAC VEIN LESIONS AND VENOUS-ORIGIN CHRONIC PELVIC PAIN.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To develop a treatment algorithm for female patients with nonthrombotic iliac vein lesions (NIVL) and venous-origin chronic pelvic pain (VO-CPP) with ovarian vein (OV) reflux, depending on the hemodynamic significance of iliac vein stenosis. METHODS: A prospective cohort study included 89 patients with NIVL and concomitant VO-CPP with the OV reflux. Patients with hemodynamically significant NIVL underwent primary iliac vein stenting (IVS) (n=49) or ovarian vein embolization (OVE) (n=10), while patients with non-significant NIVL (n=30) underwent only OVE or ovarian vein resection (OVR). Treatment efficacy was assessed by the reduction in VO-CPP and pelvic venous reflux (PVR). RESULTS: Primary IVS resulted in the VO-CPP and PVR reduction in 69.4% of cases, with a VO-CPP decrease (from 7.7±1.6 to 1.4±0.5 scores; P=0.01) and PVR type improvement from II-III to 0-I. The remaining 15 patients without changes in VO-CPP and PVR benefited from the secondary OVE 6 months after IVS. Primary OVE was associated with no changes in VO-CPP and PVR. Secondary IVS resulted in a significant reduction in VO-CPP and PVR. In patients with OVE or isolated OVR, improvements in VO-CPP (from 6.8±0.6 to 1.2±0.6; P=0.01) and PVR were observed. CONCLUSION: In patients with VO-CPP with hemodynamically significant NIVL and OV reflux, IVS may be considered as a first-line treatment option. Patients with non-significant NIVL and OV reflux have indications for the isolated OVE or OVR.

summary.title_ko: 비혈전성 장골정맥 병변 및 정맥 기원 만성 골반 통증 환자를 위한 치료 알고리즘
summary.one_line: 난소정맥 역류를 동반하는 비혈전성 장골정맥 병변(NIVL)과 정맥 기원 만성 골반 통증(VO-CPP) 환자에서, 장골정맥 협착의 혈역학적 중요도에 따라 치료 알고리즘을 제시하고, 일차적으로 장골정맥 스텐팅(IVS)이 효과적인 결과를 보였다.
summary.subjects: 89명의 여성 환자 (N=89). 난소정맥 역류를 동반하는 비혈전성 장골정맥 병변(NIVL)과 정맥 기원 만성 골반 통증(VO-CPP) 환자
summary.intervention: 혈역학적으로 유의한 NIVL 환자는 일차적으로 장골정맥 스텐팅(IVS, n=49) 또는 난소정맥 색전술(OVE, n=10) 시행. 혈역학적으로 유의하지 않은 NIVL 환자는 OVE 또는 난소정맥 절제술(OVR) 시행.
summary.results: 일차적인 장골정맥 스텐팅(IVS)은 VO-CPP 감소 (7.7±1.6점에서 1.4±0.5점으로; P=0.01) 및 골반정맥 역류(PVR) 유형 개선 (II-III에서 0-I로)을 69.4%의 환자에게서 나타냄. IVS 후에도 VO-CPP와 PVR 변화가 없는 15명의 환자는 6개월 후 이차적인 난소정맥 색전술(OVE) 시행으로 효과를 보였음. 일차적인 난소정맥 색전술(OVE)은 VO-CPP 및 PVR에 변화를 일으키지 않았으며, OVE 또는 고립된 난소정맥 절제술(OVR)을 시행한 환자에서도 VO-CPP (6.8±0.6점에서 1.2±0.6점으로; P=0.01) 및 PVR 개선이 관찰됨.
summary.implication: 난소정맥 역류를 동반하는 혈역학적으로 유의한 NIVL 환자에게는 장골정맥 스텐팅(IVS)을 우선 치료 옵션으로 고려할 수 있으며, 혈역학적으로 유의하지 않은 NIVL 환자는 난소정맥 색전술(OVE) 또는 난소정맥 절제술(OVR)이 적절한 치료 방법이다.

title: Phase I Dose-Escalation Study Combining Irinotecan-Loaded Drug-Eluting Bead Chemoembolization with Yttrium-90 Glass Microspheres Radioembolization in Colorectal Liver Metastases (DEBIR90Y).
abstract: PURPOSE: To find the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of yttrium-90 (90Y) glass microspheres, with irinotecan-loaded drug-eluting beads (DEBIRI) in patients with colorectal liver metastases (CRLM). METHODS: In this prospective study, participants with bilobar, unresectable, liver-dominant CRLM progressing after first-line systemic therapy received sequential bilobar 90Y glass microsphere radioembolization at increasing dose levels (60 Gy, 80 Gy, 100 Gy perfused normal liver absorbed dose), followed by DEBIRI, using a 3+3 dose-escalation design. The primary endpoint was MTD determination. Secondary endpoints included objective response rate (ORR) by RECIST 1.1 and PERCIST, (serious) adverse events ((S)AEs), carcinoembryonic antigen response (CEA), conversion to resection, and overall survival. Descriptive statistics and independent t-tests were applied. RESULTS: Twelve participants were enrolled. One dose-limiting toxicity (DLT; possible treatment-related fatal liver failure) occurred in the 80 Gy cohort, with no additional DLTs after cohort expansion (n=6). At 100 Gy, two additional DLTs (probable and possible treatment-related fatal liver failure) occurred, establishing 80 Gy as the MTD when combined with full-dose DEBIRI. Eighty treatment-related (S)AEs occurred, most commonly increased gamma-glutamyl transferase (12/12, grade 1-3) and abdominal pain (10/12, grade 1-2). ORR was 9% (RECIST) and 18% (PERCIST). Index lesion response rates were 20% (RECIST) and 35% (PERCIST). CEA response occurred in 42%. CONCLUSIONS: In this phase I study in patients with liver-dominant colorectal metastases, receiving a combination of yttrium-90 radioembolization with DEBIRI combined with DEBIRI, the maximum tolerated dose was 80 Gy. Considerable treatment-related toxicity was observed and objective response rates were limited.

summary.title_ko: 대장암 간전이 환자를 위한 이리노테칸 함유 약물 방출 비드 화학색전술(DEBIRI)과 위트륨-90 유리 마이크로구체 방사선 색전술(90Y Radioembolization) 병용 요법의 용량 증강 1상 연구 (DEBIR90Y)
summary.one_line: 대장암 간전이 환자를 대상으로 이리노테칸 함유 약물 방출 비드 화학색전술과 위트륨-90 유리 마이크로구체 방사선 색전술 병용 요법의 최적 용량을 결정한 1상 임상 연구에서, 80 Gy가 최대 내약 용량(MTD)으로 확인되었으나 상당한 부작용이 관찰되었다.
summary.intervention: 이리노테칸 함유 약물 방출 비드 화학색전술(DEBIRI) 후 위트륨-90 유리 마이크로구체 방사선 색전술(90Y Radioembolization). 용량 증강 디자인 (3+3 dose escalation design)을 사용, 정상 간 흡수 선량(perfused normal liver absorbed dose) 기준으로 60 Gy, 80 Gy, 100 Gy를 순차적으로 투여.
summary.results: 최대 내약 용량(MTD): 80 Gy. 객관적 반응률(ORR): RECIST 1.1 기준 9%, PERCIST 기준 18%. CEA 반응: 42%. 색전술 후 절제술 전환율은 보고되지 않음.
summary.implication: 이리노테칸 함유 약물 방출 비드 화학색전술과 위트륨-90 유리 마이크로구체 방사선 색전술 병용 요법은 대장암 간전이 환자에게 새로운 치료 옵션이 될 수 있지만, 부작용 관리가 중요하다.
summary.detailed_results: 80 Gy 투여군에서 1명의 DLT(가능한 치료 관련 치명적인 간부전) 발생. 100 Gy 투여군에서 추가적으로 2명의 DLT(확률적 및 가능한 치료 관련 치명적인 간부전) 발생. 총 12명의 환자 중 80건의 치료 관련 부작용((S)AEs) 발생. 가장 흔한 부작용은 감마글루타밀 트랜스퍼라제 상승 (γ-glutamyl transferase, 12/12명, grade 1-3) 및 복통 (10/12명, grade 1-2). Index lesion 반응률: RECIST 기준 20%, PERCIST 기준 35%.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 1상 임상연구로 환자 수가 적고, 전체 생존율(overall survival)에 대한 데이터가 부족하다는 한계점을 가지고 있다. 또한, 기존의 단일 모달리티 치료법과 비교하여 효과를 입증하지 못했다.
summary.clinical_application: 대장암 간전이 환자를 대상으로 이리노테칸 함유 약물 방출 비드 화학색전술과 위트륨-90 유리 마이크로구체 방사선 색전술 병용 요법을 고려할 수 있지만, 환자의 상태를 면밀히 평가하고 부작용 발생 가능성을 충분히 설명해야 한다. 특히 간 기능 저하 환자에게는 신중하게 적용해야 할 것이다.

title: Assessing and Improving Collimation During Fluoroscopically-Guided Interventions.
abstract: PURPOSE: An objective measure of collimation was developed and tested to determine if education and feedback might impact the use of collimation during fluoroscopically-guided interventions (FGIs). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Collimation was expressed as a collimation index (CI) where more aggressive collimation results in higher CI values. The CI metric was initially developed as part of analyzing radiation use during 15 uterine artery embolizations. It was then tested in 84 randomly selected procedures. After obtaining additional baseline data, collimation was routinely tracked. Educational sessions were held that highlighted the benefits of collimation and included feedback on collimation performance.. RESULTS: Results from 7579 procedures performed over a 13 month period found that the average CI varied substantially between procedure types and proceduralists. Some of the highest collimation indices occurred during uterine artery embolizations, particularly the embolization segments. Reference point air kerma (Kar) was used to divide FGIs into "simple" versus "complex" procedures. At baseline, simple FGIs had slightly more aggressive collimation than complex FGIs (p< 0.001). The differences in collimation between operators were most striking during complex FGIs. Following the educational interventions, the weekly average CI for all complex cases improved from 0.155 to 0.227 (p<0.05). CONCLUSION: The results demonstrate the ability to rigorously and routinely monitor collimation. Providing frontline personnel with feedback on performance was associated with improved collimation during complex procedures. The results also suggest opportunities for further improvement.

summary.title_ko: 영상 투시 유도 시술(Fluoroscopically-Guided Interventions, FGIs) 중 콜리메이션(Collimation) 평가 및 개선 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 영상 투시 유도 시술에서 콜리메이션 지수(CI)를 활용하여 의료진 교육 및 피드백을 통해 콜리메이션 사용을 개선하고, 그 효과를 입증하였다.
summary.subjects: 총 7579례 (84례의 무작위 표본 검증 포함), 시술 유형별 및 시술 의사별 데이터 분석
summary.intervention: 콜리메이션 지수(CI)를 활용한 콜리메이션 평가 시스템 구축, 콜리메이션 교육 세션 실시 및 피드백 제공. CI는 콜리메이션의 정도를 나타내는 지표로, 값이 높을수록 더 적극적인 콜리메이션을 의미한다.
summary.results: 콜리메이션 지수(CI)는 시술 유형 및 시술 의사에 따라 상당한 차이를 보였다. 특히 자궁 동맥 화학색전술(TACE, Uterine Artery Embolization) 중 색전술 구간에서 높은 CI 값을 나타냈다. 기준선(baseline) 당시 단순 시술(simple FGIs)은 복잡 시술(complex FGIs)보다 콜리메이션이 더 적극적이었다 (p<0.001). 교육 개입 후, 모든 복잡 시술의 주간 평균 CI는 0.155에서 0.227로 개선되었다 (p<0.05). 기준선 당시 단순 시술과 복잡 시술 간의 평균 air kerma 값은 사용되지 않았다.
summary.implication: 콜리메이션을 객관적으로 모니터링하고 의료진에게 피드백을 제공함으로써 복잡한 영상 투시 유도 시술 중 콜리메이션을 개선할 수 있다. 이는 환자의 방사선 노출량을 줄이고 안전성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있으며, 추가적인 콜리메이션 개선의 여지가 있음을 시사한다.

Real-World Safety and Performance of Nylon and PGLA Fibered Detachable Coils in Peripheral Embolization: A Prospective Multicenter Registry.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the Concerto detachable coil system for peripheral embolization in the Product Surveillance Registry (PSR; NCT01524276). MATERIALS & METHODS: A prospective, multicenter, global observational registry enrolled patients treated with the fibered detachable coil system for arterial or venous embolization. Patients were grouped by disease state and followed up to 12 months. Primary safety and performance objectives included technical and clinical success at index procedure, non-target tissue ischemia or embolization, occlusion of the target lesion, recanalization rate, coil compaction, and device fractures. Secondary objectives were a subanalysis of pain scores based on the Visual Analog Scale (VAS) and Patient Global Impressions Scale for Change (PGI-C) among patients with pelvic venous disorder (PeVD). RESULTS: A total of 130 patients were enrolled in this registry across 13 sites. Technical and clinical success of embolization using the fibered detachable coil system was achieved in 97.8% [95% CI: 96.28, 98.77] and 97.0% [95% CI: 93.11, 99.01] of procedures, respectively. Vessel occlusion rate was 100% at 12-months post intervention. No cases of non-target tissue ischemia, non-target embolization, target vessel recanalization, or device fracture were observed. A subanalysis of the PeVD cohort demonstrated a reduction in VAS pain scores. PGI-C was improved overall from the 30-day to the 12-month follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: The fibered detachable coil system demonstrated safe and effective performance across multiple peripheral vascular embolization disease states in real-world clinical practice.

summary.title_ko: 실제 임상 환경에서의 나일론 및 PGLA 섬유형 분리 코일의 안전성과 성능 평가: 다기관 전향적 등록 연구

summary.intervention: 섬유형 분리 코일 시스템(fibered detachable coil system)을 이용한 동맥 또는 정맥 색전술

title: SCAI/ASE/HRS/SIR/SVS Expert Consensus Statement on Enhanced Radiation Protection: Time for Mandatory and Urgent Action.
abstract: Health care professionals in fluoroscopic laboratories face significant occupational hazards, including cancer, cataracts, and reproductive concerns due to prolonged exposure to iodizing radiation, and orthopedic injuries stemming from long-term use of heavy aprons as protection from radiation. Despite substantial advancements in radiation protection technology, adoption of these advancements has been slow, hindered by the high upfront costs of implementation and the lag in revising institutional and regulatory radiation exposure thresholds to reflect the capabilities of contemporary enhanced radiation protection devices (ERPDs). This multisociety statement, endorsed by the Society for Cardiovascular Angiography & Interventions, American College of Cardiology, the American Society of Echocardiography, the Heart Rhythm Society, the Society of Interventional Radiology, and the Society for Vascular Surgery, calls for mandatory implementation of ERPDs to meet as low as reasonably achievable standards. This expert consensus statement outlines the ethical and legal responsibilities of government, fluoroscopy laboratory manufacturers, and health care institutions to protect all health care professionals from avoidable workplace hazards and the urgent need to implement ERPDs. The document does not promote or recommend any single ERPD system, and the choice of protection technology is left to department preference. It also addresses the importance of training, monitoring, and continuous research to optimize radiation safety practices. The document advocates for updated regulations and standardized practices across states to ensure comprehensive protection for all fluoroscopy laboratory personnel.

summary.intervention: 향상된 방사선 보호 장비(Enhanced Radiation Protection Devices, ERPDs)의 의무적 도입 및 관련 규정 업데이트
summary.results: 현재 의료진은 불화촬영실에서 암, 백내장, 생식기능 문제 등과 같은 직업적 위험에 노출되어 있으며, 무거운 납 앞치마 사용으로 인한 근골격계 질환도 발생합니다. ERPDs의 도입이 느린 이유는 초기 비용 부담 및 기존 방사선 노출 기준 업데이트 지연 때문입니다. 본 합의문은 특정 ERPD 시스템을 추천하지 않으며, 부서의 선호에 따라 기술 선택이 가능하도록 합니다.

Outcomes of Irreversible Electroporation for Treatment of Refractory Locally Advanced Pancreatic Cancer.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of irreversible electroporation (IRE) as salvage therapy for locally advanced pancreatic cancer (LAPC). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective cohort study was conducted of IRE performed by interventional radiologists or hepatopancreaticobiliary surgeons at a tertiary-care institution for salvage treatment of LAPC. Procedures were performed between 2010 and 2024. 30 subjects (Male/Female=18/12, Median Age=63.5) with biopsy proven adenocarcinoma, evidence of vascular encasement, and progression on chemotherapy were included. Data was collected for: patient demographics, prior treatments, tumor size, CA19-9 levels, length of treatment stay, IRE treatment parameters, adverse events, post-treatment therapies, overall survival (OS), and progression free survival (PFS). RESULTS: Of 30 patients, 14 received percutaneous IRE and 16 received surgical IRE. Nine subjects received palliative surgery with IRE. OS was 11.4 months (IQR=6-28). PFS was 7.6 months (IQR=4-21). The overall adverse event rate was 33.3%. The serious adverse event rate was 12.1%. There was no association between survival or adverse event rate and age, tumor size, tumor location, or CA19-9 level. 50% of subjects received additional treatment following IRE. OS for IRE with chemotherapy was 20.4 months. Outcome and adverse event rate were similar regardless of prior radiation treatment. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates that IRE may be a safe and effective option for salvage treatment of LAPC following chemotherapy and radiation.

summary.title_ko: 화학 요법 및 방사선 치료 후 재발성 국소 진행성 췌장암 환자를 위한 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE)의 치료 결과
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 화학 요법과 방사선 치료에도 반응하지 않는 국소 진행성 췌장암 환자에게 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE)을 시행했을 때 안전성과 효능을 평가한 결과, 생존 기간 연장에 기여할 수 있음을 시사합니다.
summary.subjects: 대상: 국소 진행성 췌장암(LAPC) 환자, N=30 (남/녀 = 18/12, 중앙값 연령 = 63.5세)
summary.intervention: 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE; Irreversible Electroporation). 피부 접근(Percutaneous) IRE 14명, 수술적(Surgical) IRE 16명 시행.
summary.results: 전체 생존 기간(OS; Overall Survival): 11.4개월 (IQR=6-28), 무진행 생존 기간(PFS; Progression Free Survival): 7.6개월 (IQR=4-21). 화학 요법 병용 시 OS는 20.4개월로 증가.
summary.implication: 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE)은 화학 요법 및 방사선 치료 후 재발성 국소 진행성 췌장암 환자의 구제 치료 옵션으로 고려될 수 있습니다.
summary.detailed_results: 합병증 발생률: 전체 33.3%, 중대한 합병증 12.1%. 나이, 종양 크기, 종양 위치, CA19-9 수준과 생존율 또는 합병증 발생률 간의 연관성은 없었습니다. 환자의 50%가 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE) 후 추가 치료를 받았습니다. 방사선 치료 병력 여부와 결과 및 합병증 발생률 사이에는 차이가 없었습니다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 후향적인 디자인으로 인해 선택 편향의 가능성이 있으며, 단일 기관에서 시행되었기 때문에 결과를 일반화하는 데 제한이 있을 수 있습니다. 또한, 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE) 시술자의 숙련도에 따른 결과 차이는 고려되지 않았습니다.
summary.clinical_application: 국소 진행성 췌장암 환자에게 화학 요법 및 방사선 치료 후에도 증상 완화와 생존 기간 연장을 위해 비가역적 전기천공술(IRE)을 고려할 수 있습니다. 특히, 종양의 위치나 크기에 관계없이 적용 가능하며, 화학 요법과 병용 시 더욱 효과적인 결과를 기대할 수 있습니다.

title: A retrospective study with a 5-year follow-up on the effectiveness of transcatheter arterial chemoembolization for locally advanced cervical cancer.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effectiveness of transcatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) for locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC). METHODS: Retrospective single-center data on patients with LACC were collected between 2011 and 2019. Patients with stage IB3 or IIA2 disease were grouped into those who underwent radical surgery alone (RS), TACE+RS, and TACE+concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT). Patients with stages IIB or IIIA disease were grouped into those who underwent TACE+CCRT and CCRT alone. The 3- and 5-year overall survival rates, surgery-related indices, and incidence of surgical complications were analyzed in each group. RESULTS: One hundred eighty-seven patients were included. Among 107 patients with stage IB3 or IIA2 disease, 68 patients were treated with TACE. Of those, 53 patients (77.9%) achieved satisfactory tumor shrinkage to proceed to surgery (TACE+RS, n=53). The 3- and 5-year survival rates of the TACE+RS group were significantly greater than those of the RS alone group (n=39) (92.5% and 69.7% vs 76.9% and 41.0%, respectively, P<0.05). TACE significantly shortened operative time and reduced intraoperative bleeding and average length of stay (P<0.05). For stage IIB and IIIA patients, who were treated with CCRT, there were no significant differences in 3- and 5-year survival rates between the TACE+CCRT (n=30) and CCRT alone (n=50) groups (83.3% and 66.7% vs 84.0% and 66.0%, respectively, P>0.05). CONCLUSION: TACE can improve the suitability of patients with stage IB3 or IIA2 disease for surgery and increase survival rates. For patients with stage IIB or IIIA disease, receiving TACE before CCRT did not provide any additional benefit.

summary.title_ko: 국지 진행 자궁경부암에 대한 경동맥 화학색전술(TACE)의 효과: 5년 추적 관찰 후향적 연구
summary.one_line: 국지 진행 자궁경부암 환자에서 경동맥 화학색전술(TACE)은 수술 적합성을 높이고 생존율을 향상시키지만, IIB 또는 IIIA 단계에서는 추가적인 이점을 제공하지 않는다.
summary.intervention: 경동맥 화학색전술(TACE), 근본 수술(RS), 동시 방사선 치료(CCRT)
summary.results: IB3 또는 IIA2 단계 환자군에서 TACE+RS 군의 3년 및 5년 전체 생존율은 RS 단독군에 비해 유의하게 높았다 (92.5% 및 69.7% vs 76.9% 및 41.0%, 각각 P<0.05). TACE는 수술 시간 단축, 수술 중 출혈 감소, 평균 입원 기간 감소와 관련되었다 (P<0.05). IIB 또는 IIIA 단계 환자군에서 TACE+CCRT 군과 CCRT 단독군의 3년 및 5년 생존율은 유의한 차이를 보이지 않았다 (83.3% 및 66.7% vs 84.0% 및 66.0%, 각각 P>0.05).
summary.implication: 국지 진행 자궁경부암 환자에서 TACE는 수술 적합성을 높이고 생존율을 향상시킬 수 있다. IIB 또는 IIIA 단계에서는 TACE가 추가적인 이점을 제공하지 않는다.
summary.detailed_results: IB3 또는 IIA2 단계 환자 중 68명(107/187)이 TACE를 받았으며, 이 중 53명(77.9%)은 수술 진행을 위한 만족스러운 종양 축소를 달성했다 (TACE+RS, n=53). RS 단독군(n=39)과 비교하여 TACE+RS 군의 수술 시간, 수술 중 출혈량, 평균 입원 기간이 유의하게 감소하였다. IIB 또는 IIIA 단계 환자에서 TACE+CCRT (n=30)와 CCRT 단독군(n=50) 간에는 3년 및 5년 생존율에 통계적으로 유의미한 차이가 없었다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 후향적이고 단일 센터에서 진행되었기 때문에 일반화에 제한이 있을 수 있다. 또한, 환자 선택 편향 가능성이 존재하며, TACE 적용 기준에 대한 자세한 정보가 부족하다. 기존 연구와 비교했을 때, TACE의 효과를 입증하는 결과는 일관되게 나타나지만, IIB 또는 IIIA 단계에서의 추가적인 이점에 대한 논란은 여전히 존재한다.
summary.clinical_application: IB3 또는 IIA2 단계의 국지 진행 자궁경부암 환자에게 TACE를 고려하여 수술 적합성을 높이고 생존율 향상을 기대할 수 있다. IIB 또는 IIIA 단계에서는 CCRT와 병행하는 것보다 단독 CCRT가 우선적으로 고려될 수 있으며, TACE 적용 여부는 개별 환자의 상태에 따라 신중하게 결정해야 한다.

title: Endovascular Embolization of Left-Sided Varicocele: Outcomes by Venographic Anatomy and Coil-Adjunct Strategy.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate outcomes after endovascular embolization for left-sided varicocele, with attention to venographic anatomy and embolic agent selection. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center cohort included 46 men treated by endovascular embolization for symptomatic isolated left-sided varicocele between May 2018 and September 2025. The median age was 27 years (interquartile range [IQR], 22-32 years), and the median follow-up was 35 months (IQR, 22.5-70.0 months). Color Doppler ultrasound (US) confirmed pathologic reflux (>2 seconds during Valsalva). Venographic anatomy was classified using a 5-category scheme (Types 1-5) adapted from Jargiełło et al (Acta Radiol 2014; 56:63). Two embolic strategies were applied at operator discretion within a uniform distal-to-proximal protocol: distal coils plus proximal n-butyl cyanoacrylate glue vs distal coils plus proximal polidocanol foam. The primary outcome was recurrence (clinical and/or color Doppler ultrasound [US] defined); secondary outcomes were technical success, clinical success, and adverse events (Society of Interventional Radiology [SIR]/Baerlocher classification). RESULTS: Technical success was 100% and clinical success was 97.8% (45/46). One recurrence (2.2%) required reintervention. Minor adverse events occurred in 2 of 46 patients (4.3%); no major adverse events occurred. Complex anatomy (Types 3-5) was present in 56.5%. In exploratory comparisons, clinical success was 94.7% with coil + glue vs 100% with coil + polidocanol (P = .41); recurrence and adverse event rates did not differ significantly by embolic strategy or anatomic complexity. The very low event rate precluded meaningful assessment of equivalence. CONCLUSIONS: Endovascular embolization for left-sided varicocele achieved high technical and clinical success with low recurrence, including in patients with complex anatomy and prior surgical varicocelectomy. The absence of detectable between-group differences should not be interpreted as equivalence.

summary.title_ko: 좌측 정맥류 색전술의 임상 결과: 정맥 조영학적 해부학적 특징 및 코일 보조 전략에 따른 분석
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 좌측 정맥류 환자를 대상으로 한 혈관 내 색전술의 높은 성공률과 낮은 재발률을 확인했으며, 사용된 색전 물질이나 해부학적 복잡성에 따른 유의미한 차이는 없었습니다.
summary.design: 후향적 단일 기관 코호트 연구 (Retrospective single-center cohort study)
summary.intervention: 혈관 내 색전술(Endovascular embolization) - 좌측 단독 정맥류 환자 대상. 색전 물질은 코일(coil)과 함께 N-부틸 시아노아크릴레이트 접착제(n-butyl cyanoacrylate glue) 또는 폴리도카놀 폼(polidocanol foam)을 사용 (수술사 재량). 정맥 조영학적 해부학적 분류는 Jargiełło 등에서 제안한 5가지 유형(Types 1-5)에 따름.
summary.results: 기술적 성공률(Technical success)은 100%, 임상적 성공률(Clinical success)은 97.8% (45/46). 재발(Recurrence)은 2.2% (1명, 재시술 필요). 경미한 부작용(Minor adverse events) 발생률은 4.3% (2/46), 중대한 부작용(Major adverse events)은 없었음. 복잡한 해부학적 구조(Types 3-5)는 전체 환자의 56.5%에서 관찰됨. 코일+접착제군(coil + glue)의 임상 성공률은 94.7%, 코일+폴리도카놀군(coil + polidocanol)은 100% (P = .41). 재발 및 부작용 발생률은 색전 물질 종류나 해부학적 복잡성에 따라 유의미한 차이가 없었음.
summary.implication: 좌측 정맥류 환자를 대상으로 한 혈관 내 색전술은 복잡한 해부학적 구조를 가진 환자 및 과거 수술 이력 환자에서도 높은 기술적, 임상적 성공률을 보이며 낮은 재발률을 나타냅니다. 다만, 두 군 간의 차이가 발견되지 않았으므로 동일성을 판단하기는 어렵습니다.

title: Single-Session Outpatient Gallstone Organ-Sparing Cholangioscopy and Percutaneous Extraction (GO-SCOPE) for Symptomatic Biliary Colic: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: To test the hypothesis that gallstone organ-sparing cholangioscopy and percutaneous extraction (GO-SCOPE) achieves high single-session technical success, durable symptom improvement, and an acceptable safety profile in patients with symptomatic calculous biliary colic who elect nonsurgical management despite eligibility for cholecystectomy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study evaluated consecutive patients who underwent GO-SCOPE between April 2024 and July 2025 at a single tertiary academic center. The procedure consisted of same-day percutaneous gallbladder access, cholangioscopy-assisted gallstone extraction with lithotripsy as needed, and placement of a percutaneous cholecystostomy or transcystic biliary drain for tract maturation. Sixty-six patients (mean age, 46.0 years; range, 25-72 years) underwent GO-SCOPE. Primary outcomes included technical success (removal of all visualized gallstones in a single session), clinical success (improvement or resolution of biliary colic symptoms), and 30-day adverse events classified according to the Society of Interventional Radiology (SIR) adverse event classification system. Secondary outcomes included residual or recurrent gallstones on follow-up imaging. RESULTS: Single-session technical success was achieved in 60 (90.9%) of 66 patients; 6 required repeat cholangioscopy for residual stones. Mean time to tube removal was 21.3 days. Among 60 patients with 3-month follow-up imaging, 2 (3.3%) demonstrated asymptomatic subcentimeter gallstones. Clinical success was achieved in 59 (98.3%) of 60 patients at 3-month follow-up and 30 (96.8%) of 31 patients at 12-month follow-up. Four adverse events occurred, including 1 moderate and 3 severe. CONCLUSIONS: GO-SCOPE demonstrated high technical and clinical success with an acceptable safety profile as an organ-sparing alternative to cholecystectomy in patients with symptomatic gallstone disease.

summary.title_ko: 증상성 담석성 담낭경련 환자를 위한 단회성 외래 담낭 보존 담도경 검사와 경피적 담석 제거술(GO-SCOPE)의 후향적 연구

Short-Term and Long-Term Changes in Renal Function Following Percutaneous Cryoablation: A Comparison of Endophytic Versus Exophytic Renal Tumors.
abstract: PURPOSE: To determine the impact of endophytic vs exophytic tumor location on renal function following cryoablation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective review of 450 procedures in 392 patients who underwent percutaneous cryoablation of renal tumors over a 10-year period was performed. Two propensity score-matched cohorts of patients with endophytic and exophytic tumors were identified. Primary outcomes were change in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) at 3 months, 6 months, 1 year, and 3 years, and progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD) to or beyond Stage 3. RESULTS: After propensity score matching, each cohort consisted of 89 patients who underwent technically successful procedures. At 3 months, eGFR declined by 7.1 mL/min/1.73 m2 from baseline in the endophytic group (P = .003), compared with 2.4 mL/min/1.73 m2 (P = .68) in the exophytic group. By 3 years, patients with endophytic and exophytic tumors demonstrated a comparable decline (7.7 and 5.9 mL/min/1.73 m2, respectively; P = .49). A greater proportion of patients with endophytic tumors progressed to CKD Stage 3b or higher at 1 year compared with those with exophytic tumors (10/76 vs 1/71; P = .01). At 3 years, there was no significant difference in proportion of patients who progressed to CKD Stage 3b or higher (7/65 vs 6/68, endophytic vs exophytic, respectively; P = .78). CONCLUSIONS: Percutaneous cryoablation of endophytic tumors is associated with early eGFR CKD stage progression, although the long-term impact on renal function is comparable with that of exophytic tumors.

title: Multicenter Randomized Trial Evaluating the Safety and Effectiveness of the Instylla Hydrogel Embolic System for Vascular Occlusion of Hypervascular Tumors.
abstract: PURPOSE: To report the results of the randomized (2:1) pivotal study evaluating the safety and effectiveness of the Instylla Embrace Hydrogel Embolic System (HES), consisting of 2 low-viscosity, liquid precursors that form a biocompatible crosslinked polyethylene glycol hydrogel, compared with standard of care (SOC) in the embolization of hypervascular tumors (HVTs). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This prospective, multicenter, randomized, noninferiority study of adults with malignant and benign HVT had dual primary endpoints of safety and effectiveness. Safety was freedom of major adverse events (MAEs) through 30 days including death, nontarget embolization, unintended tissue ischemia, pulmonary embolism, vascular injury requiring intervention, renal or hepatic failure, abscess in target organ, or toxic/allergic reaction to HES. Effectiveness (technical success) was delivery of the embolic agent to the tumor feeding vessel(s), with stasis of flow assessed by an independent blinded imaging core laboratory. Additional endpoints were assessed through 180 days. Adverse events and imaging were independently adjudicated. RESULTS: There were 150 subjects (56% men and 44% women), with mean age of 65.4 years (SD ± 12.9) and tumors of ≤ 8 cm, recruited from 22 international centers. HES-treated subjects (102) had 118 tumors and 148 vessels treated, and SOC-treated subjects (48) had 56 tumors and 72 vessels treated. Both primary endpoints were successfully achieved. Freedom from MAE was 99% (P < .001), and technical success was achieved in 88.6% of HES and 77.9% of SOC (P = .001). CONCLUSIONS: This randomized study of a peripheral liquid embolic demonstrated that the Instylla Embrace HES met its primary endpoints in the treatment of HVTs.

title: Geometric Concordance of Deterministic Tract Planning With Operator-Selected Skin Entry Sites in CT-Guided Lung Biopsy.
abstract: PURPOSE: To test the hypothesis that a deterministic tract-planning framework generates anatomically feasible skin entry locations spatially concordant with operator-selected entry sites during CT-guided lung biopsy. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This single-center retrospective study included 199 consecutive CT-guided lung biopsies performed between January 2022 and June 2025 (mean age, 66.6 ± 9.5 years; 20.6% female). Procedural CT images were analyzed using a deterministic tract-planning system implemented in 3D Slicer with AI-assisted whole-thorax segmentation (TotalSegmentator) and predefined anatomic and geometric constraints. Literature-reported odds ratios for pneumothorax and pulmonary hemorrhage were encoded as fixed coefficients to characterize procedural burden across feasible trajectories. No model training, outcome-based fitting, or patient-specific adverse-event prediction was performed. Operator-used skin entry sites were identified on procedural CT images and compared with system-derived feasible entry locations under identical geometric assumptions. Concordance was assessed using Euclidean distance and patient-position agreement. RESULTS: Diagnostic samples were obtained in 169 of 199 procedures (84.9%). Any adverse event occurred in 125 procedures (62.8%), including clinically relevant adverse events in 25 (12.6%). The median Euclidean distance between operator-used skin entry sites and the nearest tract among the 10 lowest-burden system-derived trajectories was 15.2 mm (IQR, 6.34-30.85 mm; range, 0.3-181.4 mm). Positioning agreement was moderate (κ = 0.534; 95% CI, 0.432-0.632; p < .001). CONCLUSION: A deterministic tract-planning framework generated anatomically feasible entry locations spatially concordant with operator-selected skin entry sites. These findings support reproducible visualization of feasible access alternatives within a case-specific decision space for planning review, case review, and operator training.

Specially Designed Double-Loop Versus Single-Loop 10.2-Fr Multihole Pigtail Catheters for Pleural Effusion Drainage: A Retrospective Comparative Study of Procedural Efficiency, Catheter Stability, and Safety.
abstract: PURPOSE: To determine whether procedural efficiency, catheter stability, and safety differ between specially designed double-loop (DPC) and single-loop (SPC) 10.2-F multihole pigtail catheters for pleural effusion and to assess the independent association between catheter type and instability. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This single-center retrospective study (January 2024 to August 2025) analyzed 577 procedures (DPC, n = 299; SPC, n = 278). Inclusion required 10.2-F multihole catheters under combined ultrasound (US)-fluoroscopic guidance. Minimal effusions or incomplete records were excluded. Sample size included all eligible procedures without an a priori power calculation. Primary outcomes were catheter retraction and dislodgment. Secondary outcomes included procedure/fluoroscopy time, radiation exposure, success rates, and adverse events. Multivariable logistic regression evaluated the association between catheter type and retraction. RESULTS: DPC showed significantly lower retraction (0.7% [95% confidence interval (CI), 0.1%-2.4%] vs 16.9% [95% CI, 12.7%-21.8%]; P < .001) and dislodgment (0.3% [95% CI, 0.0%-1.8%] vs 2.9% [95% CI, 1.3%-5.6%]; P = .02). On multivariable analysis, DPC was independently associated with lower retraction odds (adjusted odds ratio, 0.034; 95% CI, 0.008-0.141; P < .001). DPC significantly reduced procedure time (11.9 vs 16.3 minutes), fluoroscopy time (20.4 vs 43.7 seconds), and radiation exposure (4.6 vs 10.0 mGy; all P < .001). Technical and clinical success rates were 100% in both groups. Overall adverse event rates were low and similar (2.0% vs 1.8%; P > .05). CONCLUSIONS: DPC demonstrated lower retraction and dislodgment rates than SPC. Its intrinsic anchoring mechanism not only simplifies the procedure and obviates the need for skin fixation but also reduces overall procedure time and radiation exposure.
